threat_event: Ransomware delivered by a phishing email encrypts the office computers, the dispatch desktop, and the synced shared drive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training; flat network puts the dispatch desktop next to office computers; sync client would carry encrypted files into the shared drive and backup; signature antivirus only
existing_controls: MFA on email and SYS-01 administrators; MSP patching and antivirus; firewall
treatment_plan: Annual awareness training and quarterly phishing simulations; MSP-managed EDR with alert monitoring; dispatch desktop on its own firewall segment; 90-day immutable backup versions

threat_event: A conflicting or lost movement authority during an unplanned switch to paper dispatch leads to a collision or a roadway worker strike
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Paper dispatch is a habit, not a written procedure; never drilled; no rule for a radio roll call before the first paper authority; only 2 qualified dispatchers
existing_controls: Radio repeat-back of every authority (operating rules); 10 mph maximum speed; usually one train on the line
treatment_plan: Written paper dispatch procedure starting with a radio roll call; printed train sheet each morning; paper dispatch drill twice a year; add to the P08 runbook

threat_event: A former or current employee uses the shared crew login from an unknown device to view or acknowledge authorities and switch lists
threat_source: Former workforce member or outsider with the shared password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared crew password unchanged from 2023-05 to 2026-07-16, including after a conductor left on 2026-02-27; no MFA on the crew login
existing_controls: Crew role cannot issue authorities; password changed 2026-07-16
treatment_plan: Named crew accounts with MFA (3 more licenses); last-day termination checklist; monthly account reconciliation

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool gives attackers access to every computer, including the dispatch desktop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has administrator access to all computers; no evidence of MFA or technician list; no security terms in the MSP contract
existing_controls: MSP states it uses MFA on its console (not evidenced)
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security review (questionnaire and evidence of MFA, technician list, subcontractors); contract terms at renewal: incident notice within 24 hours, recovery time commitment, approval for remote work on the dispatch desktop

threat_event: Shared drive, mailboxes, or operations data cannot be restored after deletion, corruption, or encryption
threat_source: Backup misconfiguration or sync of damaged files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sync-based backup keeps 30 days of versions; never restore-tested; one MSP admin account without MFA; no company-held copy of SYS-01 data
existing_controls: Nightly copy by the backup service; SYS-01 vendor backups (SOC 2)
treatment_plan: First restore test; 90-day immutable versions; quarterly restore tests; weekly export of car inventory and authority history to the suite

threat_event: A cyber attack is not reported to TSA within 24 hours of discovery
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nobody knew cyber attacks are reportable under 1570.203; the 2025 mailbox compromise was not reported; no report form fields for cyber events
existing_controls: Security Coordinators designated and reachable 24/7; physical events reported to TSA
treatment_plan: Cyber triggers and the TSA report step in POL-03 and P08 (company target 12 hours); contact card; brief all staff; ask TSA how to handle the 2025 event

threat_event: Attacker exploits the unsupported operating system on the dispatch desktop, or it fails and takes the radio console with it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operating system past end of vendor support since 2025-10; excluded from upgrades at the radio vendor's request; same network as office computers
existing_controls: Antivirus; no internet browsing on the desktop (verbal rule); spare base radio
treatment_plan: Buy a new desktop with a supported operating system and the certified console version (due 2026-11); separate firewall segment until then

threat_event: SSI or the hazmat security plan is disclosed to someone without a need to know, including through data theft
threat_source: Workforce member, MSP technician, or attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 SSI-marked TSA documents and the security plan in a shared-drive folder every account can open; no SSI handling rules; desktops unencrypted
existing_controls: Suite MFA; office locked
treatment_plan: Restricted folder for the General Manager and Roadmaster; SSI handling rules in POL-04; report any unauthorized release to TSA (POL-03)

threat_event: Business email compromise sends a fake bank-change invoice to a shipper or diverts a payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 compromise succeeded through an approved push prompt; no number matching; no payment-change verification rule
existing_controls: MFA on email; the shipper called to check in 2025
treatment_plan: Number matching for MFA; written rule to confirm any bank change by phone; tell customers the rule; awareness training

threat_event: Internet outage stops access to SYS-01 from the dispatch desk and stops EDI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet line; no failover; phone hotspot is the only fallback
existing_controls: General Manager's phone hotspot; paper dispatch
treatment_plan: MSP installs a cellular failover router

threat_event: Operations SaaS vendor outage longer than the 4-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency for authorities, car inventory, and EDI
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 availability commitments (RTO 4 h, RPO 1 h); paper dispatch
treatment_plan: Accepted: vendor commitments meet the BIA and paper dispatch covers one shift; revisit if an outage exceeds 4 hours

threat_event: Radio base station or console failure leaves the dispatcher without contact with trains
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Console depends on the dispatch desktop; no tested procedure for working from handhelds; lightning season
existing_controls: Spare base radio in the enginehouse; handhelds through the repeater
treatment_plan: Test the spare base radio quarterly; add a no-radio rule to the paper dispatch procedure (trains stop until contact is restored)

threat_event: Hurricane closes the office and the line for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan or alternate dispatch location; single building at Junction
existing_controls: SaaS reachable from any location; laptops encrypted
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan: laptops and a handheld radio go home with the General Manager and Roadmaster; dispatch from the laptop by hotspot; customer and Class I notice script

threat_event: The hazmat security plan does not reflect current threats, including cyber threats to car location and shipping data, and its annual review is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Last reviewed 2025-03-18 (more than 12 months); no section on protecting hazmat car data or SSI
existing_controls: Plan exists; hazmat security training current
treatment_plan: Annual review with a short section on hazmat car data, SSI, and cyber reporting; calendar reminder each March

threat_event: Staff do not recognize or report an incident, so the TSA 24-hour clock and breach clocks are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident response plan before 2026-08; no reporting channel; no cyber training
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-03 and P08 runbook; reporting card on each desk and in each locomotive cab; annual training; tabletop

threat_event: Theft of an unencrypted desktop exposes synced employee files and SSI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 desktops unencrypted; synced shared-drive files stored locally
existing_controls: Building locked with an alarm
treatment_plan: MSP enables full-disk encryption on all 3 desktops and reports status monthly

threat_event: Takeover of the telematics portal reveals locomotive locations and hides or fakes engine alarms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared administrator login with the installation password and no MFA (found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Portal is monitoring only; no remote control of locomotives
treatment_plan: Named accounts for the Mechanic and General Manager with MFA; new password

threat_event: Breach of employee personal information (payroll, HR, certification, and drug and alcohol testing records)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Employee files in the shared drive and SYS-08; no review of the payroll vendor; Office Manager mailbox compromised in 2025
existing_controls: MFA on the suite; payroll SaaS with MFA
treatment_plan: Move employee files to a restricted folder; ask the payroll vendor for its security report; add Florida notice steps to P08

threat_event: The AI defect detection model misses a defect and the inspector, trusting it, looks less carefully
threat_source: AI model error and automation bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot started without rules; recall 83% on the pilot runs and 57% on heavily vegetated sections
existing_controls: Roadmaster still performs every required visual inspection
treatment_plan: Written human-in-the-loop rule: the model only supplements inspection; monthly recall check; no use on vegetated sections until retested (see P10)

threat_event: AI vendor keeps or reuses track and bridge imagery without agreed terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot terms never reviewed; imagery shows bridges and the propane customer's siding
existing_controls: Pilot limited to the hi-rail truck
treatment_plan: Contract terms: no reuse or training without consent; deletion on request and at contract end; incident notice (see P10)

threat_event: Lost or stolen crew tablet exposes switch lists and a signed-in session
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets travel in locomotive cabs and the hi-rail truck
existing_controls: Built-in encryption and passcode; MSP can wipe remotely; crew password changed 2026-07-16
treatment_plan: Accepted: data is encrypted and low in sensitivity; the session ends when the MSP wipes the device; residual risk Low

threat_event: A new customer starts shipping RSSM (for example anhydrous ammonia) and nobody checks the TSA duties that follow
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No TSA applicability check in the new-business process; part 1580 subpart C location and chain-of-custody duties would apply
existing_controls: General Manager approves every new customer
treatment_plan: Add a TSA and hazmat security check to the new-customer checklist
